description.value: A voxel-based morphometry study compared grey matter values among cocaine abusers, heroin abusers and healthy controls using structural MRI.

model_settings.value: Three ANCOVA analyses compared controls versus cocaine abusers, controls versus heroin abusers, and the two abuser groups directly; age and years of education were covariates. Structural images were normalized to the MNI template, segmented into grey matter, white matter, and cerebrospinal fluid, modulated for nonlinear normalization, and smoothed with a 12 mm Gaussian filter. Statistical significance was p < 0.05 cluster corrected.

spans.text: Finally, smoothed segments were entered in three ANCOVA analyses: one comparing the control group versus the cocaine abusers, one comparing the control group versus the heroin abusers and a third one comparing the two abuser groups directly. Age and number of years of education were included in the model as covariates.
